store_data.about_the_game:
The Market is Alive — And So Are the Props

Nahualli is a multiplayer prop hunt game set inside a vibrant Mexican mercado, where nothing is what it seems. Blend in among piñatas, flower pots, cuts of meat, and bowls of salsa — or stalk the aisles hunting for the impostor among the merchandise.

But this isn't your typical prop hunt.

The Twist: The Hunt Reverses

When the timer runs out, any surviving Nahualli players don't just win — they [b]transform[/b]. Inspired by Mexican folklore, these shape-shifters shed their disguises and become massive, terrifying werewolf-like creatures called Nahuals. The hunters are now the prey, scrambling to survive in the same market that moments ago felt safe.

Every match plays in two acts: comedy turns to chaos, laughter turns to screaming.

Key Features

  • Two-Phase Gameplay — Rounds start as a lighthearted prop hunt and escalate into a frantic survival horror chase when the Nahuallis transform. 

  • A Mexican Mercado Like No Other — Hide among dozens of authentic props across flower stalls, butcher shops, fruit stands, taco restaurants, and more — all dripping with cultural detail.

  • 2-8 Players — Perfect for quick sessions with friends or chaotic full lobbies. 

  • Rooted in Folklore — The Nahualli draws from real Mesoamerican legends of shape-shifters who walk among us in disguise.

  • Cosmetic Progression— Unlock new skins and appearances as you play more matches.

Early Access — What's Coming

Nahualli launches with one fully realized mercado map packed with hiding spots and atmosphere. During Early Access, we plan to add:

  • 2 additional maps with new environments and props

  • More cosmetic unlockables

  • Community-driven balance updates

  • Quality of life improvements based on player feedback

Your feedback shapes the future of Nahualli. Come be part of the hunt.

The tragedy of the Tepes family was the beginning of a curse...

A new adventure in the Toziuha Night series! With a classic 8-bit style and chiptune music, you’ll play through various semi-linear levels to face familiar enemies and new bosses! Whether you play alone or with a friend, the challenge will be waiting for you! However, you’ll also have the option to use modern controls.

Classic characters return for a new adventure!

You'll be able to revisit areas to find rewards and secrets, and it includes a map to help completionists unlock 100% of the content. Find clues and solve puzzles to help you find a solution to the Nosferatu curse!

Inspired by that proto-Metroidvania game released in 1987... Don't let the horrible night fall before you break the curse!

store_data.about_the_game:
Don't Click, Hantavirus is a tense third-person stress simulator where you control literally just one finger — but every second might be your last.

Goal and challenges

Your main task is to survive as long as possible while balancing three critical meters:

If any of these three meters reaches a critical point — game over. You lose not only by accidentally pressing the button, but also by losing control of the situation.

Game mechanics

You control a cursor (your finger) in real time. The closer your cursor is to the red button, the slower the virus spreads. And if you bring your finger extremely close, the virus gets scared and starts retreating — the infection level goes down. The farther you move your finger, the faster the virus spreads.

But there's a catch: your character's stress level keeps rising. The higher the stress, the stronger the trembling, the more random spasms appear, and the more sluggish the controls feel.

To reduce stress, you use items — but every such item costs money from the state budget. The economy is not infinite.

Distracting duties

While trying to keep your finger above the button, new tasks keep coming:

Ignore these tasks — social order drops. Do everything — stress rises faster.

Progression and modes

Story mode
Each level unlocks a new activity or item. Difficulty increases with each stage. At the end of each level, a news report changes your perception of the situation.

Endless mode
Unlimited survival mode. All mechanics are active at once. Goal: survive as long as possible.

Visual atmosphere

Your desk is surrounded by atmospheric details: the president's photo, the national flag, an old fan, flickering monitors. They don't affect gameplay — they just set the mood.

What makes the game unique

Unlike most stress simulators, here you control literally just one finger. No complex combinations. But this minimalism turns the game into a psychological trial: you know what to do — but your own hand keeps failing you.

store_data.about_the_game:
"He did not die a hero in the way stories tell it..." -

The city of Ebenezer is burning. The revolution that protected the people for 500 years has been toppled in a single night. The man who is responsible for it all is the only one still fighting. His name is Elior. He made 3 mistakes. His wife is lifeless due to the final mistake he made. He buried her the morning of the invasion, in the warm red sand, a few klicks outside the city. He returned afterwards.

He now stands in the courtyard and waits for the inevitable.

Elior has no health bar.

Elior has no traditional health indicator. He has a Flame Meter, which represents his remaining life force; this meter drains constantly and depletes even faster when he uses his powers, and it cannot be restored. Everything has a cost, and in battle each decision takes something he cannot get back. The question has never been whether his time reaches zero. The question is what he spends it on.

Elior's six comrades are fighting a losing battle across the burning city. As each hero falls, their elemental ability passes to him (Earth, Wind, Light, Shadow, Water, and Fire), enriching and improving his power but also accelerating his inevitable end. Their memories appear in Elior's thoughts during combat, when they perish, the thoughts suddenly go silent, as if they never existed.

There is no version of this story where Elior survives. There is no ending where sins are reversed... There is only a story of a person's character when the outcome has already been determined. What will you choose to do about sins that cannot be forgiven nor a fate that can be changed?

Before the gate crumbles, look around. You won't get another chance.

Features

  • A flame meter that depletes constantly and cannot be restored—manage it or burn faster

  • Six crusader abilities to absorb across the battle, each expanding your power and shortening your life

  • Rich, posture-based combat rewarding precise, sustained combos over button mashing

  • A three-minute pre-battle exploration window: read the walls and examine the statue; you must understand what is being lost.

  • Collectible lore scattered through the arena, imperial conscription letters, torn pages from the Book of Ardor, inscriptions that point to a larger world

  • A story that opens with one line and earns its ending

Penance is the first game in the Ardor universe.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lovecraft Survivors

A pixel-art survivor-like steeped in cosmic horror. You play a lone survivor in the depths of Infernus, where the air thrums with the dreams of sleeping gods and reality bends around what should not be. Every 2:30, a Great Old One awakens. At minute 30, the Final Awakening occurs.

⚔ Survive the Pantheon

Face a roster of five rotating bosses, each with their own kit:

  • Cthulhu — cosmic waves and meteor showers

  • Omnigazer — magic eye projectiles and a sweeping eye laser

  • Shoggoth Boss — bile pools and frontal arcs

  • Agis — runic sigil bombardments and slam combos

  • The Black Goat — telegraphed eye-lasers and twin minions

When the timer runs out, The One Who Awakened rises. Defeat him to win the run. Defeat him without taking damage for the most coveted achievement.

✦ Build Your Kit

Start with one basic attack. Across each run, choose from 10 weapons (max 6 simultaneously), each with 5 levels of growth. Master your kit to unlock 5 weapon evolutions:

  • Tomo Devorador — orbiting books detonate in radial waves

  • Tormenta Cósmica — lightning chains between enemies

  • Pacto Eterno — accumulated damage taken can be detonated for massive AoE

  • Yugo Sellado — persistent stun sigils trace your path

  • Marea de Ícor — progressive slow puddles that thicken as enemies cross

☽ Lovecraftian Atmosphere

Hand-crafted pixel-art biome (Infernus): blue-flame braziers, sarcophagi, eldritch sigils on the ground. There is no day-night cycle — it is always dark, and the dark whispers back. A custom soundtrack of dark-orchestra rumbles in 120 BPM accompanies every encounter.

🏆 23 Achievements

From easy starters (Survive 1 minute, First Blood) to endgame challenges (Complete Pentagram: earn all 5 evolutions in a single run; Immaculate: defeat the final boss without taking a single hit). Full Steam achievement integration.

Will you survive the dreams of those who should not be?

store_data.about_the_game:
The night the kingdom fell, you alone survived. From the ashes of a broken throne, forge a deck, master the elements, and march back into the dark to face the Lord of Shadows.

**Kingdom of Ashes** is a single-player roguelike deck-builder where every run is a desperate climb through a procedurally woven map of battles, elites, shrines, mysteries, and bosses. Draft cards, stack relics, chain resonances, and bend each encounter to your will — or be unmade by it.

### Key Features

- **Roguelike Deck-Building** — Start with a fragile hand, end with a tuned engine. Every battle adds, upgrades, or culls cards. No two decks are alike.

- **Eight Fallen Heroes** — Unlock a roster of survivors, each with a unique starting deck, signature mechanic, and trait perks that evolve through Mastery levels.

- **Elemental Resonance** — Play three cards of the same element in a single turn to trigger Resonance. Diversify with the Runecaster's Rune Chain to unlock escalating bonuses across 3, 4, 5, and 6 unique elements.

- **Procedural Run Maps** — Branching paths across 12 rows, with rare map variants like Diamond, Twin Spire, Crossroads, Skull Alley, and River. Choose your route: safe grind or high-risk gauntlet.

- **Living Encounter Nodes** — Battles, Elites, Bosses, Shops, Rests, Treasures, Shrines, Mysteries, Echoes, Mimics, and Gauntlets each twist a run in different directions.

- **Persistent Meta-Progression** — Earn Ash from every run. Spend it at the Forge to permanently upgrade your arsenal, unlock new heroes, and stockpile advantages for the next descent.

- **Ascension Tiers** — Beat the game, then climb harder. Each Ascension layer reshapes encounters, enemies, and economy for veterans hungry for pain.

- **Relic Codex** — Discover and catalog dozens of relics, each with stacking interactions that reward clever deck synergy.

- **Localized in 10 Languages** — English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Vietnamese.

### Built for One More Run

Tight runs. Hand-tuned encounters. A soundtrack of ember and ruin. Lose, learn, forge, return. The kingdom is ash — but the crown is still down there, waiting.

store_data.about_the_game:
Evil Chef Showdown is a female-oriented, cartoon-styled 2.5D game built with Unreal Engine 5, featuring an entirely female cast.

Players take on the role of a chef who dreams of competing in Nine Hells Kitchen Showdown. However, while signing up for the competition, she accidentally clicks the wrong website and ends up registering for a bizarre knockoff reality show called Evil Chef Showdown. What she doesn’t realize is that this shameless parody of Nine Hells Kitchen Showdown is actually hosted by a real demon chef straight from Hell.

The reality show’s cast includes producers, head chefs, sous-chefs, mascots, waitstaff, and contestants from all walks of life. After signing a contract with the production crew at the beginning of the game, failure is no longer just embarrassing — losing means having your soul devoured.

(In theory,) you will experience:

  • Exciting and intense puzzle stages

  • A strong sense of accomplishment after clearing levels

  • Delightful (?) character interactions

Anyway, Evil Chef Showdown is still only a half-finished project for now, but we hope you enjoy it!

store_data.about_the_game:
1. Track Unlock Rules

The game has three music categories, all tracks are completely free. Unlock rules are as follows:

1. Each category starts with one track unlocked. Completing unlocked tracks earns tokens, which can be spent to unlock any track you choose;

2. Hard and Chaos difficulties require no tokens – they unlock progressively when the required score on the previous difficulty is reached.

2. Customization Features

1. In the Workshop levels, you can customize audio, wallpaper, and note charts.

3. Dynamic Wallpaper Feature

1. Turn on Wallpaper Mode to set the game’s dynamic background directly as your desktop’s live wallpaper;

2. Supports switching between game and wallpaper mode. After setting as desktop wallpaper, right-click the tray icon to return to the game;

3. Check “Auto-enter wallpaper mode” in settings – each time you open the game, it will automatically enter wallpaper mode, and you can switch back to the game interface anytime via the tray icon.

Special Notes

1. The default note generation method differs from traditional rhythm games’ score-reading generation: notes are randomly generated, and each time you enter a level, the timing of note generation is completely different;

2. The game supports custom charts. When creating a song, you can choose to use a musical score and create a corresponding chart, or import a CSV/TXT file to create a chart;

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Introduction

The story is set in a fictional northern mountain village during the 1970s.
The protagonist, Er Kui, is heavily influenced by kung fu movies of that era and becomes obsessed with martial arts. One day, a gang of hooligans suddenly storms into Er Kui’s home, brutally beats him up, steals his tractor, and even takes away the rooster he has raised for many years.

Furious beyond control, Er Kui decides to teach those punks a lesson and sets out on a path of revenge.
The story is absurd, humorous, and hot-blooded at the same time, with a light homage to John Wick.

Gameplay Features

Don’t Mess with Er Kui is a hard-hitting action beat-'em-up game packed with satisfying combat. During Er Kui’s journey for revenge, players will encounter all kinds of thugs and uniquely designed bosses. Find their weaknesses and defeat them!

  • At certain moments, Er Kui must make important choices. Your decisions will influence the progression of the story to some extent.

  • Er Kui will also face various challenges, such as being trapped in locked rooms. You’ll need to help him search for clues and escape.

  • During Er Kui’s journey for revenge, he may encounter trapped animals. Rescue them, and they will help you fight against enemies.

Controls

Don’t Mess with Er Kui supports both Xbox 360 controllers and PC keyboard controls. However, for the smoothest gameplay experience, I highly recommend playing with a controller.

  • Operation instructions are as follows.

Additional Information

Don’t Mess with Er Kui is coming soon!
Thank you to everyone who has shown interest and support for the game. Please consider adding it to your wishlist!

Your support is my greatest motivation. Stay tuned, and thank you!

GAME OVERVIEW

You woke up in Grandma's house.

It's late at night.

Grandma is asleep.

Something feels wrong.

If something changed—

If nothing feels wrong—

Keep walking.

Correct choices let you progress.

Wrong choices may bring something closer.

Walk through the hallway and carefully observe your surroundings.

As you progress, small changes and anomalies may appear in the environment.

Some changes are obvious.

If nothing changed, continue toward the bathroom.

Correct decisions allow you to progress.

• Inspired by childhood fears and late-night paranoia
• Short immersive horror experience

Summer vacation.

Grandma's house.

The place that always felt safe.

Until tonight.

You wake up alone.

And the hallway feels different.

15-60 minutes

store_data.about_the_game:
DESCEND. RELOAD. REPEAT.

NEONFALL is a top-down twin-stick roguelite shooter. The neon megatower is flooding from the bottom up, and you have to fight your way down faster than the water can rise. Every floor is a fresh procedural room of enemies, hazards, and chip drops; every death is permanent and sends you back to the top with a fresh build.

CORE GAMEPLAY

▸ Twin-stick combat — WASD to move, mouse to aim, every bullet is dodgeable.

▸ Grapple-hook traversal — fire a line at any wall or enemy and yank yourself across the room.

▸ Dash with i-frames — short cooldown, lets you punch through bullets at the right moment.

▸ Bullet-time — fill a meter by chaining kills, then trigger slow-motion to thread the needle through impossible crossfire.

▸ Combo system — kills within a 2.5-second window stack a multiplier; broken combos cost score and chips.

FIVE WEAPONS, FIVE PLAYSTYLES

▸ Pistol — fast, accurate, infinite-feel starter.

▸ SMG — high fire-rate sprayer, wide spread.

▸ Shotgun — 8-pellet close-range knockback.

▸ Plasma rifle — heavy single-shot, clean and lethal.

▸ Railgun — slow charge, pierces six enemies in a line.

SEVEN BIOMES, FOUR BOSSES, ONE RUN

The game ships with seven hand-tuned modes, each its own biome with unique enemies, hazards, and music track:

▸ TOWER — 30 floors, the main campaign.

▸ MALL — 15 floors of pink-light retail horror with mannequin enemies.

▸ CRYO — 12 floors of freezing labs and drone swarms.

▸ LAVA — 18 floors of flame imps and collapsing platforms.

▸ COOP — 10 co-op-tuned floors built for two.

▸ NIGHT — 13 floors of stealth-flavoured stalker encounters.

▸ HELL — 10 endurance floors against scaling shadows.

Each biome ends with a multi-phase boss — ZARA-9000, the Cryo Sovereign, the Inferno, or the Void — each with their own attack patterns and arenas.

BUILD YOUR RUN

Between floors you choose:

▸ Perks — pick 1 of 3 (Steel Lungs +30 HP, Longreach grapple, Overcharge damage, Time Sink bullet-time, Wet Repair regen, Quicksilver speed).

▸ Shop — spend chips on permanent upgrades and consumable med-patches.

▸ Weapon swaps — drop your starter for whatever the floor offers.

Every run is a different build. You will lose. You will get further next time.

STEAM P2P CO-OP

Built on Steamworks networking — no servers, no accounts, no friend codes. Invite a Steam friend, host a lobby, and one of you joins the run in progress. Both players share the same flood, the same chips, the same boss. Drop-in / drop-out supported.

ORIGINAL SYNTHWAVE SOUNDTRACK

Eight original tracks — one per biome plus a full-length album cut. The score reacts to where you are in the run: calm during traversal, distorted under low HP, full-volume during boss fights.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX

▸ 7 game modes / biomes

▸ 4 multi-phase bosses

▸ 5 weapons, 6 stackable perks, full shop

▸ Steam P2P 2-player co-op

▸ 8-track original soundtrack (plays in-game)

▸ Steam Cloud saves and achievements

▸ Full controller support, rebindable keyboard

▸ Estimated playtime: 8–15 hours to clear the Tower; 30+ hours for all biomes and boss kills

store_data.about_the_game:
"Space Opera Roguelite"

No turning back. Only breaking through.

PNR: Point of No Return is a 2D roguelite shooter where you take direct command of a spaceship. From nimble assault crafts to imposing battleships — the romance and atmosphere of retro space opera, brought to life.

The Sorties Repeat. The Memories Carry Forward.
You have fought this battle before. PNR: Point of No Return is built around a loop narrative. Why won't this war end? That answer is yours to uncover. Push through the cold, lonely void alongside unforgettable characters and formidable ships — and find the truth.

Every Ship Changes the Battlefield
Each ship comes equipped with its own unique weapons, offering a completely different playstyle the moment you make your choice. Combine weapons every run and forge your own build.

Tactical Units: Your Light in the Dark
The worse the odds, the brighter your tactical units shine. Mix and match dozens of skills to build differently every run, then deploy support ships with powerful abilities — bombardment, area suppression, defense and more — to turn the tide. One well-timed deployment can decide the entire engagement.

Key Features

  • Weapon Combinations — Choose, combine, and craft your own combat style

  • A Different Build Every Run — Infinite variation through leveling choices

store_data.about_the_game:
Defying Fate: 60 Days to the Exam is a strategy simulation game that seamlessly blends immersive storytelling with hardcore time management.

In a world where social classes are rigidly solidified, the college entrance exam is the last lifeline for the underdogs to break their chains of fate. You are a teacher with a mysterious background, assigned to take over a "trash class" completely abandoned by society.

Facing a reclusive shut-in, an arrogant heiress on the verge of bankruptcy, and a violent street brawler... you don't need to be friendly. You must use overwhelming authority to shatter their pathetic pride, forcing them to achieve an impossible transformation in the final 60 days.

【Key Features】

 Hardcore 60-Day Time Management
108 classes, 9 weekends. Not a single second can be wasted!
"Average effort" will lead to a total wipeout. You must master the deep growth mechanics: strategically tolerate weak subjects early on, use the ultra-rare 9 weekend story events to fundamentally reshape the underachievers, and schedule classes with absolute precision in the late game for explosive score growth. This is the ultimate stat-maxing strategy, reserved only for the smartest players.

Tear Open the Scars of Broken Families
Behind these problem students lies a web of cold corporations, desperate slums, and a hypocritical education system. During weekend home visits, dive into their thorny inner worlds, resolve their traumas, and awaken their sealed academic potential.

The Razor's Edge Between Heaven and Hell
The game features a brutally realistic multi-ending system.
Achieve high scores, and you will single-handedly create a miracle, sending them to the pinnacle of society. Fail, and the darkest abyss of lifelong suffering awaits them.

The countdown has begun. Teacher, can you save them all?

store_data.about_the_game:
Design, expand, and optimize underground transit systems inspired by real-world metro networks. Create stations, connect lines, manage trains, and grow your network as passenger demand evolves across different cities and regions. Build efficient routes, reduce congestion, and keep your metro moving during rush hour!

Featuring region-inspired maps, realistic train models, and metro systems based on real-world transport infrastructure, each network offers its own style and operational challenges.

Features

Build, expand, optimize, redesign, panic-fix, and somehow keep your metro moving during rush hour. It gets chaotic fast! In a good way.

  • Multiple gameplay styles: play casually and grow your dream network, optimize every line for maximum efficiency, or push your system to the limit under constant passenger pressure.

  • Design your metro your way. Create stations, shape routes, manage transfers, and expand your network across evolving city layouts.

  • Multiple region-inspired cities and metro systems! Build networks inspired by Berlin, Moscow, Tokyo, London, Paris, Madrid, New York, Milan, and more — each with different layouts, pacing, and infrastructure challenges.

  • Dynamic passenger growth and changing network demands mean every playthrough develops differently. The perfect layout in one game might collapse completely in the next.

  • Watch your metro evolve into a living system of colorful lines, dense interchanges, and moving trains — turning every map into its own transport diagram.

  • Realistic-inspired train models, infrastructure, and station designs based on real-world underground systems.

  • Day mode, night mode, and clean minimalist visuals designed for long management sessions.

  • Trains. A lot of them. Probably still not enough during rush hour.


All those cities. Endless ways to build.

Design underground transit systems across region-inspired networks based on cities like Berlin, Moscow, Tokyo, London, Madrid, Paris, Milan, and New York — each with different layouts, passenger flow, and operational challenges.

movies.name: Moto Trial Turbo — Official Announcement Trailer

store_data.about_the_game:
Speed, Balance, and One Perfect Run

Moto Trial Turbo is an arcade-style 2D motorcycle trials game where bike physics, precise controls, and intense tracks turn every run into a battle for seconds.

Hit the throttle, keep your balance, use turbo at the perfect moment, and complete each level cleaner, faster, and bolder than before. It’s not just about reaching the finish line — it’s about feeling the bike: knowing when to take a risk, when to slow down, when to lift the front wheel, and when to carefully survive the next section.

Moto Trial Turbo Features

  • Challenging but exciting tracks

  • Level editor!

  • Play the best levels created by the community

  • Ghost replay of your own run

  • Global player leaderboard for every track

  • Collectible stars — sometimes hidden

Compete for the Best Time

In Moto Trial Turbo, the finish line is not the end of the level — it’s the beginning of your next attempt. Online leaderboards let you compare your results with players around the world and return to completed tracks to sharpen your skills.

Create Your Own Tracks

When the standard challenges are no longer enough, open the level editor and build your own runs: short high-speed tracks, technical routes with jumps, or difficult obstacle courses with traps, portals, gravity, and moving platforms.

Place terrain, objects, checkpoints, traps, collectible stars, and special elements, instantly test your level in playtest mode, and fine-tune the track until it has the right rhythm — fair, challenging, or even completely insane.

Play Community Levels

Moto Trial Turbo doesn’t end with the built-in tracks. Play levels created by other players! Some players build challenges, others try to beat them, and others turn them into races for the best time. This makes the game an almost endless playground for new runs.

store_data.about_the_game:
PP INFLATION is an incremental/idle game paying tribute to classic Ping Pong games, except you don't control your paddle. Instead, spend points on upgrades and watch your points swell.

Choose Your Upgrades

At certain score milestones, pick from random upgrades to unlock, and level them up as you earn more points. Your build takes shape one decision at a time and compounds the further you go. Freely reallocate skill points to optimize your point-income.

Skills and Synergies

Unlocked skills range from passive income, to debuffs for the enemy paddle, to buffs for your own paddle. Some naturally combine well together, while others have special synergies or unlock other skills that make them even more powerful. A few examples:

  • FIRE BALL ignites the enemy paddle, sending it into a panic. This skill unlocks PYROMANIA.

  • CANNON BALL stuns the enemy on impact, or extends an active burn from FIRE BALL. This skill unlocks CANNON BOMB.

  • MONEY BALL rolls a chance for a bonus point every goal. This skill unlocks GOLD BALL.

  • GREASE BALL makes the enemy paddle slip and slide around clumsily, combining well with FIRE BALL.

  • SLIME BALL slows the enemy paddle on hit, or makes GREASE BALL even more slippery.

Leveling up your skills costs increasing amounts of points, so you decide between specializing or spreading your points around. Eventually, you'll unlock the exponentially more powerful "SPECIAL SKILLS", which can drastically multiply your point gains based on your build, such as granting points every time the ball bounces or granting a % of your total at regular intervals.

Stages and Victory

Score enough points and you'll progress to the NEXT STAGE. Each stage has a theme and a few unique flavor interactions with the stage environment that can even earn you extra points, such as busting asteroids, opening treasure chests, or exploding mines.

Each stage requires exponentially more points to reach. Once you complete all stages, your CLEAR TIME and peak PTS/MIN are recorded on a personal leaderboard.

Features

  • 14+ stackable skills with build-defining synergies

  • 5+ unique stages with interactive bonus objects

  • Game-changing SPECIAL SKILLS that multiply your point engine

  • Personal leaderboard tracking clear time and peak points-per-minute

  • 20+ Steam Achievements

Soundtrack

PP INFLATION comes loaded with 55 tracks of retro-electronic, chiptune, and EDM music by Lesiakower. Titles range from high-energy (Full Speed Ahead, Epic Battle, The Mayhem) to atmospheric chiptune (Bitwise, I Dream in Keygen, Pixel Perfect). An in-game music player lets you see what's playing and skip tracks, loop the current stage song, or shuffle them all.

A brutal frozen mountain where mistakes are never forgiven.

After a catastrophic blizzard, you become the last manager of an isolated mountain shelter.

Take charge of a remote emergency shelter and protect the stranded survivors who have gathered there to endure the relentless cold.

Rescue survivors lost in the snow, manage food, fuel, medicine, and supplies, and keep the shelter running. Each survivor has their own health condition, personality, abilities, and needs.

Simply maintaining the shelter will not be enough.

Organize exploration teams and send them into the dangerous snowy wilderness to gather resources, rescue new survivors, and uncover hidden locations and events beyond the storm.

[Key Gameplay]

• Manage survivors and monitor their condition

• Operate critical resources including food, fuel, medicine, and supplies

• Dispatch exploration teams on rescue and supply missions

• Maintain shelter facilities and daily operations

• Respond to emergencies and unexpected events

• Face survival outcomes shaped by your choices

Resources are always limited.

Fuel runs low.

Food spoils.

Medicine disappears quickly.

Who will you save?

Who will you send into the deadly cold?

Who will receive your limited resources first?

Every decision has consequences.

Become the last hope in the frozen mountains and keep the shelter alive.

     Only atmosphere, sound, and emotion. A bittersweet fairy tale you will want to return to again and again.
     KRENDEL — a warm, atmospheric, and unforgettable adventure for those who love to explore with their heart.

One rainy night, the protagonist notices a café that has never been there before.

Inside, it is warm and smells of coffee and wet clothes. Behind the counter stands a tired, composed barista. A man in a dark coat watches from the window. At the tables, people argue about what makes a story feel alive: mystery, form, voice, memory, or the one who stays until the end.

Features:

  • one route, no branching paths;

  • a compact story for one evening;

  • a rain-soaked café, strange visitors, and the growing sense that the night is no longer following ordinary rules;

  • atmospheric artwork and an original soundtrack.

store_data.about_the_game:
Skip the lengthy character creation and focus on the fun of combat!

Kick the Dungeon is a card-based tactical roguelike game that uses the SRD 5.1 rules. Assemble your unique party, craft your own build, and enjoy the thrill of battle. Use cards to unleash familiar spells like Fireball and Magic Missile — every run offers a completely different experience.

Kick The Dungeon is a turn-based tactical RPG inspired by DND 5E-style combat. Build your party, enter dangerous battle maps, and defeat a wide variety of enemies through positioning, skill timing, equipment choices, and team composition.

The game focuses on tactical combat progression. You choose from multiple class-based characters, form a party, and fight through different regions and battle stages filled with goblins, beasts, undead, constructs, and other enemies. Every battle is shaped by initiative order, movement range, attack distance, skill area, armor class, damage rolls, and saving throws. Victory depends not only on raw damage, but also on positioning, target priority, and smart use of each turn.

The current version includes 6 playable class templates, such as Fighter, Wizard, Rogue, Ranger, Cleric, Paladin, Each class offers a different combat role and playstyle, including frontline defense, ranged attacks, spellcasting, healing, burst damage, and mobility. Choosing the right team setup has a major impact on how each encounter plays out.

The game currently features 200+ skill entries, 90+ monsters, 50+ pieces of equipment, and 30 battle stages across multiple regions. Players will explore battlefields such as forests, mazes, scorched lands, and towers, facing different enemy groups, elite encounters, and large creatures. Terrain, enemy combinations, and party composition all create different tactical challenges.

Combat is built around clear turn phases. Each unit acts according to initiative and uses movement, actions, bonus actions, and reactions to influence the battlefield. You will need to balance melee attacks, ranged damage, spells, healing, buffs, and debuffs while adapting to the changing situation of each fight. Area attacks, single-target burst, status effects, and reaction-based mechanics can all turn the tide of battle.

If you enjoy turn-based strategy, party-building, grid-based tactics, and fantasy combat inspired by tabletop mechanics, Kick The Dungeon offers a combat-focused experience built around planning, execution, and satisfying tactical victories.

store_data.about_the_game:
Exiled Ark is a top-down sci-fi survival crafting shooter set against the grand backdrop of the rise and fall of humanity’s interstellar civilization. It constructs a profound interstellar worldview that stretches from the outbreak of Earth’s apocalyptic crisis in 2032, through the Interstellar Age of Exploration in 2174, to the Solar System War in 2377, which reduced humanity’s homeworld to complete ruin.

In 2375, humanity’s last colonial starship fled Titan, Saturn’s moon. Plagued by interstellar disasters, it lost contact and drifted in the cosmos for centuries, becoming the sole remaining hope of mankind wandering among the stars.

Centered on space exploration and top-down shooting, the core gameplay tasks players with scavenging resources across desolate interstellar voids and wrecked giant colonial vessels, while facing constant unknown threats. The game features an extensively open equipment crafting system that allows free creation of diverse items. Combined with freely deployable and relocatable base-building mechanics, players can establish their exclusive strongholds for interstellar survival.

Combat adopts a roguelike trait system, paired with six core attributes including Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence, as well as a massive roster of unique traits such as Terminator, Psionic Aptitude and Force Awakening. Players are free to customize their specialization builds, granting a fresh combat experience every encounter.

The game also includes four exclusive tech trees, covering Material Science, Interstellar Navigation, Mechanical Ascension and Genetic Neo-Human evolution paths. Unlock ultimate capabilities ranging from exoskeletons and nanomachinery to genetic editing and psionic perception. It also offers a dual companion system of robots and mutated creatures, alongside unique gameplay features like space message relays and gravitational wave detectors, allowing players to uncover deep hidden storylines and cosmic secrets across the stars.

Four distinct endings are unlocked based on AI favorability and starship system restoration progress. Amid the standoff with the ship’s artificial intelligence, you will single-handedly determine the future of human civilization.

Going forward, we will continuously polish the gaming experience, expand interstellar exploration scenarios, add new traits and story side quests, and enrich cosmic survival content, bringing players an ever more immersive interstellar survival journey.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to a neon world where every step could be your last!

You are a small, sunny hero, thrown into endless procedurally generated dungeons. Each level is unique—platforms, traps, enemies, and secrets are recreated each time you play. No two playthroughs are the same.

Gameplay:

  • Jump across platforms, over chasms and deadly spikes.

  • Collect coins and find hidden treasures hidden in destructible blocks.

  • Evade patrolling enemies or destroy them by jumping from above.

  • Find keys to open locked passages and move on.

  • Destroy blocks—some hide rare coins and bonuses.

  • Collect shields for additional protection.

Score bonuses:

Every 5,000 points—an additional shield (maximum 7). A shield absorbs one hit instead of death.

Every 25,000 points earns an extra life (maximum 10).

Features:

  • Procedural generation – each level is created anew, endless replayability

  • Multiple jump system – use them wisely to reach hard-to-reach places

  • 12 achievements – from the first jackpot to three levels in a row without dying

  • Global leaderboard – compete with players from all over the world for the best score

  • Stylish neon graphics – bright colors against a dark background create the atmosphere of a mysterious digital world

Controls:

Left/Right Arrows or A/D – Move

Up Arrow, W, or Space – Jump (can jump in the air up to 7 times)

Up Arrow – Also destroys a block above your head

Down Arrow or S – Destroys a block under your feet

P – Pause

M – Turn music on/off

N – Turn sound on/off

ESC – Menu

Summon:

Levels become increasingly difficult. More enemies, more traps, fewer safe paths. How many levels will you complete? Can you make it into the world's top 10?

Simple controls. Endless challenge. One goal: get as far as possible.

store_data.about_the_game:
Can you survive the pressure of power?

Crisis Cabinet is a turn-based political strategy simulation where you lead a nation through elections, unrest, scandals, economic pressure, war and national emergencies.

Every turn gives you limited political capital and too many problems to solve. Raise taxes or cut spending. Fund healthcare, defence, policing, welfare, education or infrastructure. Respond to crises before they spiral out of control. Keep the public on side, hold your party together, and watch for the warning signs of unrest, collapse or coup.

Rule through crisis

As leader, you will face a constantly shifting political landscape. Voters have expectations, budgets have limits, and every decision creates consequences. A popular policy may damage the economy. A tough security response may restore order but hurt legitimacy. Ignoring a crisis may save resources now but create a much bigger problem later.

Key features

- Turn-based political strategy across multiple terms in office

- Manage political capital, public support, stability, legitimacy and unrest

- Set national budgets across key government departments

- Respond to crises including scandals, protests, economic shocks and security threats

- Fight elections and balance competing voter groups

- Handle war, diplomacy and national emergencies

- Survive long enough to shape your legacy — or fall from power

Early Access

Crisis Cabinet is launching in Early Access so players can help shape the balance, pacing, scenarios and long-term depth of the game. The core game is focused on political decision-making, crisis management and emergent storytelling, with further improvements planned during development.

A strategy game about consequences

There are no perfect choices. Every policy has a cost. Every crisis has a political price. Every compromise changes the country you are trying to lead.

The question is not just whether you can win power.

The question is whether you can survive it.

RumbleRush is a chaotic multiplayer parkour racer where you play as a fruit or vegetable — a tomato, a carrot, an orange, a watermelon — sprinting and jumping through wildly designed obstacle courses built to make you fall. The tracks don't move. They don't have to. They're already brutal enough.

Massive gaps between platforms. Narrow ledges over open air. Ramps that launch you somewhere you didn't plan to go. Climbs that look possible until you're halfway up and realize everyone else already fell. The course itself is the enemy — and your opponents are a close second.

store_data.about_the_game:
SpellBlind is a platforming rogue-like. Play as a wizard with a new job delivering mail across the scattered cities of Typety. Destructive magic has corrupted the land and made monsters of the wildlife that occupy it. Unlock your true potential (as a mailman) by jumping and fighting your way through rooms of all shapes and sizes, and think outside the box to reach new areas, find more items, and create unique spells.

For hundreds of years no sensible creature has dared cross the outside. Only now will the untold secrets of the territories be reclaimed, and the history of what's been lost be revealed. After all, one must be curious to be a wizard.

  • Explore the diverse regions and the many ways to traverse them

  • Become familiar with a cast of hostile creatures and their erratic habits

  • Find charms that, with the right touch of magical intuition, unleash tremendous power.

Whether you're hopping off lily-pads or floating in bubbles, there are many ways to traverse the lands of Typety. Expect to encounter many different platforming challenges, and be ready to come up with different ways to solve them from run to run.

When magic is left unmanaged, it tends to fester and grow... The creatures of Typety have been corrupted by this essence. Be cautious as you go, you never know when you might be stumbling upon something that's more than meets the eye.

Hey, what? You're supposed to be delivering mail!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Horse Spirit Valley
──────────────────────────────
Step into a soft, sunlit fantasy where the rhythm is simple: ride, sparkle, dress up your mount, and unlock new pastures when you’re ready for the next view. No rush—just you, the trail, and a pocket full of dreams.

🐎 Ride & explore
────────────────────
• Third-person horseback adventure across handcrafted 3D valleys—grass, light, and space to breathe.
• Every outing has a honest goal on the HUD: collect every diamond tucked into the world.
• Nail the set and the UI celebrates a full clear—a small victory lap for collectors who love a tidy map.

💎 Diamonds that work for you
──────────────────────────────────
• Gems you pick up stick with you between sessions—your balance is always on screen.
• Sink savings into new environments beyond your starter pasture, or into cosmetic unlocks for your horse.
• Low on glitter? The interface tells you straight—no opaque economy tricks.

🦄 Make the horse unmistakably yours
──────────────────────────────────────────
• Deep dressing room: size, coat, mane style & tint, saddle & reins, armor look & color, horn shape & color.
• Preview everything in the customization hub, save a look you adore, and spend diamonds when a premium style calls your name.

🗺️ Pastures waiting past the horizon
──────────────────────────────────────────
• The map picker shows art, title, and price—play what you own or buy the next dreamscape with saved diamonds.
• Your first world is ready on day one; the rest open when you decide the valley has earned another stamp in your passport.

🌍 Play your way
────────────────────
• Tweak resolution, dial real-time shadows for performance, flip music—this is your session.
• A shuffled soundtrack keeps menus and rides from feeling samey; fairy-tale calm follows you scene to scene.

🎮 Controls that respect the couch
──────────────────────────────────────
• Keyboard & mouse feel natural; gamepad users get menus that behave.
• Pause, adjust, or bounce to the main menu when life interrupts the ride—progress stays where you left it.

🏆 Steam, quietly cheering you on
────────────────────────────────────────
• Achievements reward first rides, diamond milestones, full clears, visiting every map, saving looks, shopping, and coming back for more.

✨ Who it’s for
──────────────────
Horse Spirit Valley is a low-stress, high-satisfaction pocket of magic: wander, shimmer, restyle, unlock, repeat. If gentle fantasy, shiny goals, and a unicorn-worthy mount sound like your kind of Sunday—saddle up.

📣 Stay in the loop
──────────────────────
Wishlists help wandering players find the valley. Thanks for riding along with a small, heartfelt indie adventure.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome aboard.

At the Picky Harbor Ferry Co., every passenger has preferences, opinions, and very specific seating requirements.

As the company’s newest boarding coordinator, your job is simple:

  • assign seats,

  • organize cargo,

  • and avoid complete social disaster before the ferry leaves the harbor.

Some passengers want to sit near the window.
Others refuse to sit next to tourists.
Some get seasick.
Some smell like fish.
Some are tourists carrying suspiciously large luggage.

And somehow… everything still needs to fit.

Arrange passengers aboard cozy ferry boats while solving increasingly chaotic spatial puzzles. As your shifts become more demanding, you’ll also need to organize cargo in a satisfying inventory-style system inspired by classic grid-based games.

From quiet local ferries to overloaded tourist boats, every trip introduces new passengers, new problems, and new combinations to untangle.

Features

  • Cozy and relaxing puzzle gameplay

  • Seat passengers according to their unique preferences

  • Organize cargo using inventory-style spatial puzzles

  • Discover quirky passengers and absurd situations

  • Multiple ferry layouts and increasing complexity

  • Charming harbor atmosphere and lighthearted humor

At Picky Harbor Ferry Co., passenger satisfaction is serious business

`CharaDiary` is an idle character-raising diary game with built-in creation tools. You can create growth stories for original characters, or for fan-made subjects you have the rights to create, and let those characters gradually grow through everyday clicks, keystrokes, and companionship. Along the way, they will trigger events, leave diary entries, and reach different endings.

Players can start by loading the built-in content pack, or create their own game content packs by setting growth stages, prologues, main story events, daily events, choice branches, side stories, and ending conditions. Players can also use the theme pack editor to adjust the interface, giving each character a diary screen that suits them.

Diary and Replay: Record growth milestones, event choices, side story unlocks, and ending experiences.

Steam Workshop: Players can share their own content packs and theme packs, or subscribe to works created by others.

store_data.about_the_game:
Built by Day, Bitten by Night is a cozy voxel city-builder with a small problem: when the sun goes down, the zombies arrive. And the pirates. And the yetis, robots, and UFOs.

Lay out a sleepy hamlet of farms, fountains and mansions through the warm afternoon. Train soldiers, raise walls, stack mage towers and dragons. Then watch the sky turn red as moonrise brings waves of enemies to your gates — and your archers fire the first arrow of the night. How long can your keep stand?

This is the strategy / tower defense / city-builder hybrid for players who want both halves of the genre in one game: the meditative joy of arranging a perfect little kingdom by daylight, and the white-knuckle adrenaline of holding the line when the horde rolls in. It's the kind of game that's oddly satisfying to play — the click of a coin, the snap of a wall, the crack of a mage tower bolt — and dangerously addictive to put down. Just one more day. Just one more night.

Build By Day

Grow a voxel kingdom from a single stone keep into a sprawling realm. Houses, mansions, farms, chicken coops, pig pens, mage towers, cannons, catapults, tanks, barracks, dragons, rocket towers. Tax your villagers gently, keep them happy with fountains, statues, hedges and lamp posts, and watch your population tick from 5 souls into the dozens. Plant crops, harvest apples that fall from your trees, crack open glowing crystals that emerge in the corner mountains every few days, and grab treasure chests scattered across the corners of the island. Stack ground blocks under towers for range bonuses. Demolish anything for a 50% refund.

Crown the King

Save up 10,000 gold and crown your own King — a one-of-a-kind voxel NPC who walks the kingdom on his own. He's an auto-collector, not a fighter: he wanders day after day, vacuuming up your floating coins so you don't have to. The more coins he eats the fatter and slower he gets (capped at 50% chonkier) — until morning, when he marches out of the keep fresh again. He doesn't pick fights, but if someone hits him he swings a hammer that hits like a freight train. At dusk he heads home, climbs to the top of the keep, and — when the keep is under attack or a UFO drifts overhead — raises his hammer to summon Mjolnir-style lightning that crashes down on the threat. Long live the King.

Defend By Night

Dusk arrives. The music turns dramatic. The horde marches.

Regular zombies, skeleton armies pouring out of graveyards, pirate raiders disembarking from longships, plus huge boss fights against the Zombie Boss, the Giant Yeti, the Big Bad Robot, and the Zombie UFO — each with its own HP bar, off-screen direction arrow, and dramatic ragdoll dismember animation when dawn finally catches them. Walls, gates, towers and mage towers do the static work. Cannons and catapults hit hard with splash damage. Tanks, dragons and catapults are full RTS units — left-click to select, right-click to send them anywhere on the map. Train soldiers from barracks. Survive till sunrise for a survival bonus that scales with your day count.

Big Horde Nights

Every fifth night is a Boss Night — twice as long, dramatic music, a massive boss that crash-lands when slain. Every tenth night is a Horde Night: 30–40 weaker enemies flood the map at once for a They-Are-Billions moment. And every hundredth night the screen turns black and red and the words flash up — "THEY ARE BILLIONS! They're coming from all sides!" — as hundreds of enemies pour onto the map at once. The FPS-friendly weak-spawn pool keeps everything butter-smooth even at peak chaos. Will your walls hold?

A Living Island

The world isn't a backdrop, it's a place. A real-time day/night cycle rolls through dawn, gold-hour day, dusk, and starlit night. Winter rolls in every 7–10 days, turning grass white and waking the Yeti — farms freeze, apples stop dropping, snowmen siege the gates. Storms sweep in with lightning and rain. Pirate ships sail the offshore horizon and drop loot chests when they leave. Seagulls flap over the early-game map. The ocean ripples behind every passing ship; fish jump on lazy afternoons.

Two Ways To Play

  • Survival — full enemy escalation, boss nights every 5 days, pirate nights every 4, horde nights every 10, massive nights every 100, harder waves as your treasury grows.

  • Peaceful — no enemies, ever. Just you, the calm soundtrack, and an island to make beautiful. Music stays on the soft day tracks all night long.

  • Three world sizes — Small, Medium and Large — pick your scale.

Epic, Cinematic Soundtrack

Four hand-crafted music tracks (two day, two night) cross-fade smoothly at dusk and dawn — never restarting, never jarring. Crank it up: in Peaceful Mode the day music keeps playing through the night so the cozy vibes never break. Master volume sliders for music and effects live in the pause menu and persist across sessions.

Your Kingdom, Saved Forever

  • Auto-save every 10 seconds plus a dawn checkpoint every day — exit any time and pick up exactly where you left.

  • Resume / Start New buttons appear on the menu the moment a save is detected.

  • Save & Exit writes your progress to disk before the window closes.

  • Restart wipes everything for a fresh run with the mode picker.

  • Run stats panel inside the pause menu shows live counts: population, kings, kills, gold, mansions, defenders, walls, happiness — your whole reign at a glance.

Hand-built Voxel World

Every tree, building, animal, soldier, zombie — and your fat happy King — is a sculpted voxel model. Real-time shadows track the sun. Particles celebrate every coin floated, every boss exploded, every leaf falling at the start of winter. Antialiased silhouettes, soft shadows, season-aware lighting.

Inspired by the greats

Built by Day, Bitten by Night is a love letter to a decade of cozy and brutal builders we grew up on — Kingdoms and Castles, They Are Billions, Diplomacy is Not an Option, Going Medieval, Northgard, Kingdom Two Crowns, Tiny Glade, Townscaper, and Banished. Cozy when you want it. Brutal when you don't. Strangely satisfying either way.

How long will you survive?

Try Early Access and share your feedback!

The speedy and stylish action of the Luminous Avenger series is back!

Our hero Copen must use his new "Divide Edge" energy swords to protect his home from otherworldly invaders!

After defeating the berserk AI dominating the world, he supports its new protector Blade, maintaining an uneasy peace.

Feature 2 - Muse of Hope Lola's Seven Transformations

Lola now creates more than EX Weapons from defeated enemies: she also gets new modes.

Use her unprecedented variety of transformations to take on any challenge.

store_data.about_the_game:
TIAN NUO — A Chinese dark indie game. Pure, straightforward hack-and-slash.

We promise to bring back that classic feeling in its purest form. No pay-to-win schemes. No screen-filling purchase prompts. Just a place where our younger days can finally call home.

Story Overview

Set against the backdrop of ancient Chinese mythology, this multiplayer online role-playing game unfolds in the realm of "Dahuang." Demons and ghosts run rampant across the land, and humanity faces an unprecedented catastrophe. Players take on the role of a commoner created by Nuwa, the primordial goddess of creation. Receiving revelation from the Five-Colored Divine Stone left behind by Nuwa in the mortal realm, they awaken to their true calling and embark on a journey to save humanity's homeland.

Version Overview

A Traditional Eastern Mythos, An Epic Adventure

Step into the world of "Dahuang" and embark on a journey to save humanity's homeland. From art style and map names to character costumes and monster designs, every element is drawn from classic Chinese mythology, including Shan Hai Jing (Classic of Mountains and Seas) and Sou Shen Ji (In Search of the Supernatural). Through authentic Eastern cultural symbols, you will be immersed in an ancient dark fantasy realm where danger lurks at every turn—a world where mortals, gods, and demons coexist. With the guidance of Nuwa, the primordial goddess of creation, you will forge your path through self-cultivation and demon-slaying.

Three Classes, Clean and Streamlined Progression

Players may choose their path from the Ranger, Wizard, or Fangshi — a Taoist mystic. Throughout your journey, you will gradually acquire skills, equipment, and other resources, then further refine your character into specialized sub-class branches. Each class offers unique abilities, combat styles, skills, and gameplay, providing multiple viable playstyles to master.

Online Multiplayer & Unique Social Features — Clan Support

The game features built-in chat and friend systems, letting players communicate freely and team up for adventures. It also offers a unique spectate function: with your permission, other players can watch your screen in real time and chat with you while viewing your perspective.

Build meaningful connections by forming parties, joining clans, entering sworn brotherhoods, or getting married. Forge precious bonds of friendship and family that strengthen your resolve to fight for humanity.

True Free Trading

Trade gear and items freely with fellow players, supported by a full auction system. Every adventurer who steps into Dahuang can find their own path and trading niche.

Epic Gear, Transparent Sources

Slay monsters and conquer the realm. Every resource and piece of equipment comes from a clear, defined source. Collect powerful weapons, armor, bracers, and accessories. Use gathered materials to upgrade your gear, carry potent items into battle, and seize epic loot from mighty regional bosses.

Pure, No-Nonsense Combat

In this brutal world, combat is the only way for the strong to survive. Cultivate your character, raise your level and combat power, refine your skills, and arm yourself. Dominate the world and forge your own unique build within this clean combat system. Multiple PvP and PvE modes deliver raw, visceral combat satisfaction.

store_data.about_the_game:
Do you believe in curses?

An invitation from the Ignis Hotel shatters Allen's peace...

Behind every door lies a completely different world...

A puppet singing theater lullabies,

Scattered limbs in a circus,

A human-shaped ice sculpture splattered with paint in the snow-covered forest...

Countless fragmented cases are piecing together a shocking conspiracy connected to Allen!

The game boasts a complete and logically sound storyline, divided into six interconnected and progressively unfolding chapters. Each chapter is intricately plotted, with foreshadowing and unexpected twists that gradually propel the main story forward. From a fog-shrouded beginning to a complex web of clues and intricate plot developments, the game ultimately unveils the ultimate truth, maintaining a fast-paced and engaging narrative. A complete playthrough takes approximately 12 hours. Each chapter features its own unique world, core puzzles, and subplots, with a well-balanced difficulty level that caters to both casual players seeking an immersive cinematic experience and hardcore puzzle enthusiasts seeking deductive reasoning.

The game utilizes a unique American oil painting style to create cinematic, immersive environments, crafting a mysterious, oppressive, and atmospheric suspense world. The retro, dark color palette, the hand-drawn details concealing clues, and the atmosphere perfectly complementing the plot's twists and turns ensure that every exploration is filled with the unknown and mystery. This game abandons meaningless filler puzzles; all mechanism solving, clue gathering, and logical reasoning are deeply integrated with the main storyline. Players must piece together fragmented clues, solve scene-specific mechanisms, and gradually peel back layers of fog to uncover the lies and secrets hidden beneath the surface.

A journey to uncover the truth, exclusively for you, has begun. Through repeated interactions with the scenes, you await to unravel the long-forgotten mysteries of time and space...

store_data.about_the_game:
Tactics Wanderer is a classic-style Strategy RPG (SRPG) that emphasizes deep character customization and tactical decision-making. As the lead developer at Critical Damage Studio, I have poured my passion into creating a nostalgic yet fluid experience, featuring over 40 distinct classes and a gripping narrative.

Core Gameplay Features

• An Epic Journey: Navigate through a rich campaign featuring no less than 24 strategic chapters.

• The Seven Heroes: Command 7 main units, each with a deep progression tree. Evolve your characters through Tier 2,    3, and 4, with branching paths (2 choices per tier) for every level.

• Strategic Support: Utilize specialized support units, including Backpackers, Blacksmiths, and Bards,

  to turn the tide of battle.

• Class Masterclass: Discover and master over 40 unique classes, allowing for endless tactical combinations.

Units & Combat Systems

• Skill Customization: Beyond innate class skills, enhance your units by equipping Skill Rings.

  Combine these with class abilities to create devastating skill combos tailored to your playstyle.

• Resource Management: Skills are divided into Active and Passive. Active skills require strategic

  use of Mana or Items as a cost to deliver immediate impact on the battlefield.

• Equipment & Crafting: Standard weapons do not have a durability system and can be used indefinitely.

  However, powerful Masterwork weapons crafted by the Blacksmith offer superior stats but come with limited     durability.

• Challenge Your Strategy: There is no permanent death in the standard mode. However, for those seeking a challenge,

  Hard Mode features a "Zero Casualty" rule—if any player unit falls in battle, it is an immediate Game Over.

The Story

After generations of conflict, the seven kingdoms of the Athelon continent finally united in peace. But the tranquility was shattered by the Armond, a mysterious and relentless race from an unknown land. Refusing all diplomacy, the Armond have besieged Athelon for a desperate bid for survival, Athelon has formed elite expeditionary units
to sail toward the unknown origin of their invaders. Journey alongside 7 Heroes from the 7 Kingdoms to uncover the truth behind the Armond and find a way to end the war forever.

Technical Limitations & Notes (Please Read)

Please note that this game is developed by a solo developer. Before purchasing, please review the following technical constraints:

• Fixed Resolution: The game supports 720p (1280x720) resolution only.

• Language Switching: Changing the in-game language requires a manual step.Users must place the desired language      file into the game's specific folder.Detailed instructions are provided within the game menu.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by these technical limitations and appreciate your understanding and support for this indie project.

store_data.about_the_game:
Requires internet connection (for DeepSeek API calls)

Users need to obtain and configure their own DeepSeek API Key

GAL-Chat is not a traditional visual novel, but a living, growing AI interactive storytelling world.

There are no pre-written dialogue trees, no "A/B/C" options. On your desktop, you will engage in real-time voice or text conversations with AI characters who possess their own personalities and memories.

Core Features

True AI-Driven Dialogue

Powered by the DeepSeek API's advanced natural language capabilities, characters no longer repeat pre-written lines. You are free to type anything - from casual small talk to profound questions - and the character will respond with unique, emotionally rich replies based on its personality, memories, and current scene.

Immersive Visual Novel Experience

Dynamic character sprites with expression changes: Character sprites change their emotions based on the conversation.

Scene switching: A right-side drawer-style background list lets you change the scene at any time to match your story's atmosphere.

Visual novel-style text box: Classic line-by-line display and auto-read mode preserve the authentic Galgame interaction feel.

Long-Term Memory System

The game features a structured memory system. The AI not only remembers your conversation from five minutes ago but also stores key events, relationship changes, and your personal preferences over the long term. This means every word you say truly shapes this relationship.

Multi-Character Ensemble and Interaction

Left-side drawer-style character list: Load multiple characters simultaneously and switch who you are talking to at any time.

Character-to-character interaction: AI characters can talk to, argue with, or cooperate with each other. You become the witness or director of this ensemble drama.

Deep Customization System

Character setting editing: Freely modify a character's personality, backstory, and speaking style in the settings interface.

User setting editing: Define your own identity and experiences so AI characters interact with you in a more fitting way.

History and memory review: Access the complete conversation history at any time, along with automatically generated memory summaries, giving you a clear picture of the story you are building together.

For players who:

Enjoy Galgames / visual novels but are tired of fixed options and repetitive content.

Want to experience true AI companion-style storytelling and seek unique conversations every time.

Desire multi-character interactions and want to build their own AI ensemble drama.

GAL-Chat has no ending - because your story with her will never see its final chapter.

Controls

Type text and press Enter to send

Toggle fullscreen with F11 or right-click menu

Switch characters by selecting character card folders on the home screen

Add characters by hovering over the left-side drawer-style character list

Switch backgrounds by hovering over the right-side drawer-style background list

BGM player is accessed by hovering over the top drawer-style player

View history via the right-click menu

Apply settings via the right-click menu (configure API Key)

Enable the character's proactive dialogue feature in the settings interface at the bottom of the settings panel, set the interval time. Triggered after the user initiates a conversation

Adjust volume using the mouse wheel while hovering over the center of the window (hold Ctrl + scroll wheel to zoom up to 500%)

store_data.about_the_game:
Everest Base Camp is a single-player management simulation game about running a high-altitude expedition base on Mount Everest.

You are responsible for the daily operation of a base camp: preparing clients, assigning support staff, managing supplies, watching the weather, and deciding when an expedition should move forward — or turn back.

Every decision carries risk. A promising weather window may close. A client may not be ready. Supplies may run short. Pushing too hard can damage your reputation, your budget, and the people under your care.

Build and operate your camp, respond to events, and guide expeditions through the dangerous rhythm of high-altitude climbing.

Key Features

- Manage a high-altitude expedition base camp

- Prepare clients through acclimatization and training

- Allocate supplies, staff, time, and money

- Watch weather windows and route conditions

- Make difficult decisions about advance, retreat, rescue, and risk

- Experience story events inspired by the realities of extreme-altitude expeditions

- Grow your reputation as an expedition operator

Everest Base Camp is currently in development. The first playable demo will focus on the early expedition route from Base Camp toward Camp I.

store_data.about_the_game:
Garden Eternal is a cozy incremental game about growing a small, strange garden that has a quiet mind of its own. Click to make it grow and tend it through every season. There is no clock and no losing here. Just try not to wonder too hard about who tended it before you.

At the center of it all beats the Garden Heart. Click it, and the garden grows. Raise bees, ponds and glasshouses that keep it growing while you are away, then click in quick little flurries to set off a Mega Bloom. It is the most satisfying button you will press all year.

Hidden in the soil is a quiet little card game. Open packs, draft cards, and equip just three at a time. The right three can turn a calm garden into a glorious, blooming machine.

  • A cozy idle clicker, happy with long sessions or quick check-ins

  • A garden that keeps growing while you are away

  • A little deckbuilding game hidden in the soil

  • Four seasons that turn everything as they pass

  • Monsters, debts, and visitors who knock after dark

  • Handmade pixel art & soundtrack for every season

store_data.about_the_game:
【Game Overview】

鐵血霸業傳奇 is a Three Kingdoms-themed legendary role-playing game. You begin as an unknown warrior and explore war-torn lands, challenge monsters and bosses, collect equipment and materials, and grow stronger through character progression, equipment upgrades, and warrior development.

【World Background】

In the final years of the Eastern Han dynasty, the empire falls into chaos as warlords rise across the land. As battles spread through the realm, you will rise from an ordinary fighter into a powerful leader, fighting through different battlefields and factions to build your own empire.

【Core Gameplay】

Explore maps inspired by the Three Kingdoms era and challenge monsters, bosses, and higher-level battle areas.

Gain equipment, materials, and progression resources through combat, exploration, and boss challenges.

Upgrade equipment, forge powerful weapons, and steadily improve your combat strength.

Recruit and develop warriors, build different progression paths, and prepare for harder challenges.

Take part in faction, siege, and guild-related content as you pursue long-term growth and greater goals.

【Equipment and Progression】

Equipment is a key part of character growth. Players can obtain gear through combat and exploration, then improve it through enhancement, upgrading, and forging. As your strength increases, you will unlock more challenging maps, bosses, and gameplay content.

【Long-Term Content】

The game will continue to expand around dungeon challenges, boss battles, equipment progression, warrior development, faction gameplay, and siege content. We will continue improving combat, progression, and long-term goals based on version updates and player feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit stacking arcade game where you drop fruits with a crane, merge matching Parfait Crane is a physics-based 3D fruit merging arcade game where you control a crane, drop fruits into a parfait cup, and aim for the highest score through efficient merges.

The goal is not simply to build a tall tower. Your objective is to combine fruits through 11 stages, create larger fruits, trigger explosive chain reactions, and push your score as high as possible before the parfait collapses.

Each fruit drop changes the entire situation. Fruits roll, slide, collide, bounce, and settle through physics. A careful drop can create a stable setup, while one unexpected movement can trigger a massive merge chain.

Merge two matching fruits to create the next fruit stage and earn points. The higher the fruit stage, the greater the reward. Plan your drops, manage the limited space, and look for opportunities to set up satisfying chain reactions.

Key Features

11-Stage Fruit Merging

Combine matching fruits through 11 fruit stages and aim for higher-scoring merges.

Explosive Chain Reactions

One good drop can trigger a burst of consecutive merges, creating the most satisfying moments in the game.

Score Attack Gameplay

The main goal is to earn the highest score possible through efficient placement, smart timing, and lucky physics.

Crane-Based Controls

Move the crane, choose your drop position, and release each fruit at the right moment.

Signalman Shake

Use the Signalman role to shake the fruits and create unexpected movement. A well-timed shake can rescue a bad situation, disturb the stack, or help trigger a powerful chain reaction.

Physics-Based Uncertainty

Fruits do not always behave exactly as planned. They roll, collide, settle, and sometimes betray your expectations.

Cute but Dangerous

The game looks sweet, but one unstable drop or one risky shake can turn your parfait into a collapsing mess.

Steam Leaderboards

Compete for high scores and see how your best run compares with other players.

Hwaseo is a Korean folk dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelike set in the fallen Kingdom of Cheonryeon.

Form a party of three characters, build a deck from their unique cards, and face strange beings inspired by Korean folklore. Each battle combines strategic card play with real-time reactions, allowing you to defend, parry, and respond directly to enemy attacks.

Explore ruined villages, forgotten shrines, and cursed lands where old tales have twisted into something darker.

Tactical Deckbuilding with Korean Folk Talismans

Collect, upgrade, and combine cards inspired by talismans, rituals, and Korean folklore. Shape your deck around offense, defense, support, or powerful character synergies.

Build a Party of Three Souls

Choose three characters and combine their cards into a single deck. Each character brings different skills, roles, and synergies, creating new strategies with every run.

React Directly to Enemy Attacks

Combat is not only about choosing the right card. Time your defenses and actions against enemy attacks to reduce damage, create openings, and turn the battle in your favor.

A Dark Fantasy World Inspired by Korean Folklore

Journey through the fallen Kingdom of Cheonryeon, where spirits, monsters, and forgotten stories linger in the ruins. Encounter strange events and beings shaped by old tales.

store_data.about_the_game:
Game Overview
PegPigeon is a casual physics peg game built for short sessions: you launch balls through a colorful peg board, rack up score on impacts, and settle into bottom slots for big payoffs. Between rounds you draft upgrades and relics to shape each run, while hub progression unlocks new stages, pigeons, skins, and long‑term meta upgrades.

Worldbuilding
A light, cartoon‑fiction setting—no historical tie‑ins. Pigeons are the playful mascots of a “peg arena”: bright boards, bouncy walls, and trick slots that change mood from stage to stage (meadow, barn, snowfield, and more). Tone is relaxed, family‑friendly, and built for quick fun rather than story cutscenes.

Core Gameplay
Each round gives you a limited number of launches. Aim and fire; the ball cascades through pegs, triggers special peg rules, and finally drops into a slot lane where multipliers and scoring rules apply. When the round resolves, you open the in‑run shop, pick one of several random offers (an upgrade or a relic), and push deeper into the run. Clear the stage’s round target to finish a session and move on to settlement, gold, and unlock checks.

Features

  • Multi‑stage boards with different layouts and gimmicks per stage.

  • In‑run shop: random draft cards; rerolls tied to meta progression.

  • Relics (Jokers) with passive or trigger effects; slot count can grow via meta.

  • Meta upgrades (balls per round, salvo cap, end‑run gold, shop rerolls, wall score, slot multipliers, and more).

  • Gold economy from runs and achievements; spend on meta upgrades and pigeon skins.

  • Achievements with manual claim rewards.

  • Per‑stage leaderboard snapshots for bragging rights against your own bests.

  • Settings for audio (and related comfort options as shipped).

How to Play

  • From the hub, pick an unlocked stage and tap Start.

  • During a round, aim and launch the ball; try to chain peg hits and steer toward high‑value slots.

  • When the shop appears, tap one card to add that upgrade or relic to your run; use Refresh if you still have rerolls.

  • Repeat rounds until you hit the stage’s configured limit or fail state—then review score and gold, return to hub, and spend gold on meta upgrades, pigeons/skins, or chase achievements.

  • Use Pause for a breather and Settings to tune sound to taste.

store_data.about_the_game:
You work for Freedom Delivery Solutions — an official United States Government contractor specializing in energy security, strategic deterrence, and the timely delivery of democracy to volatile regions.

Your current assignment: the Strait of Hormuz.

Your General has a target. He needs oil at a specific price per barrel. He's given you a deadline. He hasn't given you much else — except a fleet, a deck of cards, and an opinion on everything.

Your mission is simple. The execution is anything but.

  • Deploy warships to escalate conflict or enforce a ceasefire until you are ready.

  • Play strategy cards: airstrikes, embargoes, diplomatic pressure

  • React to live Situation Room events: OPEC decisions, geopolitical shocks, rogue state provocations

  • Watch the oil price ticker — every action has a market consequence

The catch? Your General is spectacularly unqualified, some call him an idiot. He'll tweet during crises. He'll claim credit for your victories. A sharp political satire wrapped in a strategy game.

"Any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, is purely coincidental. Tremendously coincidental. The best coincidence. Nobody has ever seen such a coincidence."
